cohort: 100 patients with confirmed diagnosis of placental abruption
finding: Gestational age at presentation was an important factor in fetal outcome in placental abruption, with 66% of babies presenting before 32 weeks gestation being IUD/stillbirth.
mod_finding: 58% of patients delivered vaginally and 42% had caesarean section.
gest_age: varied, but 30 babies presented before 32 weeks gestation
